text: Water polo | Georgian national team defeated Turkey and took a big step towards the World Cup #1TVSPORT

The Georgian water polo team played a round of 16 match of the World Cup qualifying round against Turkey and won 19:12. This was a worthy revenge for the defeat against the same team in the group stage.

With this win, the Georgians advanced to the quarterfinals, where their opponent will be determined later (the winner between Canada and Ukraine). To qualify for the World Cup, the Georgian team needs to win two more matches – the quarterfinals and the semifinals. Two finalists will qualify for the World Cup Super Final.
The 2026 Water Polo World Cup will be held in Australia from July 22-26.
